entry.title: DJFX Looper Native 1.1.3
entry.summary: DJFX Looper Native 1.1.3 is a free, scope-free MPC OS audio insert with three native Q-Link knobs, FX ON, the authentic Rare Data logo and an on-device Help page. Length: 230–12 ms. Speed: −100 through zero to +100. Loop: OFF through halfway; ON above halfway. Length shapes the rolling sound with Loop off; FX ON controls dry bypass.
